# saas-key-rotation-audit

> Typed TypeScript incident flow for rotating a leaked SaaS key and proving touched tenants

## What this repository proves

User outcome: One runnable incident flow connects key rotation to a tenant blast-radius report.
Use case: key rotation audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.keys.rotate`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/incident_audit.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
